marker_blind_shortcut.interpretation: The frozen validation split does not identify marker grounding because a joint marker-blind nuisance rule predicts every validation turn. Marginal contingency checks do not repair this confounding.

output_color_nuisance.interpretation: Orientation is confounded with output-color inference unless the native task demonstrations prospectively and unambiguously establish the output color.

condition_identifiability.interpretation: Condition identity cannot remain metadata-only. Each condition must be expressed through legitimate condition-specific native ARC demonstrations, with no validation target in the prompt.

v1_disposition.scientific_use: The immutable V1 cohort remains valid as generator and descriptive provenance. It is not valid for confirmatory marker-grounding inference. If a previously unknown V1 receipt is later recovered, its result may be described only with these confounders and must not be merged with V2.

e04_v2_amendment.counterfactual_rule: For every selected canonical base tuple, hold shape, layout, reference relation, topology and all color roles fixed while generating all four explicit turn-marker values.
e04_v2_amendment.marker_blind_guard: Every nuisance-identical quartet must contain all four turn values and corresponding targets. A predictor that excludes the explicit marker must be structurally incapable of solving all four members. Verify this by exhaustive matched-set assertions, not only marginal balance.
e04_v2_amendment.condition_observability: Construct a separate native ARC task for each condition using condition-specific TRAIN-only demonstrations. Do not expose condition names, latent metadata, split labels, hashes, or validation targets to the model.
e04_v2_amendment.output_color_control: Within each native task, TRAIN-only demonstrations must unambiguously establish the query output color while holding the color-role convention fixed prospectively. Balance output colors across canonical statistical units.
e04_v2_amendment.validation_target_boundary: Freeze and hash input-only prompts before model loading. Keep validation targets in a separate scorer sidecar and freeze raw generations before joining targets.
e04_v2_amendment.uncertainty_and_support: Preserve the prior base-tuple-level stratified bootstrap, seed 20261010, 10000 replicates, minimum conditional support of 8 per reserved cell, and protected-retention requirements.

requirements: When the resolved Controller pane is already working, do not prompt it again and do not immediately spin the persistent loop.
Apply a bounded backoff, then re-read ARC2_WORKFLOW_STATE.json before any subsequent dispatch decision.
Do not overwrite a disposition written by the active Controller with a stale in-memory state.
Preserve at-most-once dispatch and active-remote-job protections.
Add an integration test in which workflow disposition changes while Controller is already working.
